title: Canonical Map Revision
description: The map revision a floor is canonically on, published retained by the registry at mote/v2/registry/site/<site>/floor/<floor>/current so an agent that reconnects learns it immediately.

floor.description: Floor whose canonical revision this is. One floor is one SLAM session, i.e. one map frame.

revision.description: Immutable revision id, the timestamped directory name a robot stages into maps/<rev>/.

url.description: Path on the fleet server to fetch the packed revision from, relative so it stays correct however the box is reached.

sha256.description: sha256:<hex> of the packed bundle, checked by the puller before anything is staged.

bytes.description: Size of the packed bundle, so a robot can decide before downloading.

promoted_by.description: Operator who promoted this revision to canonical.

stamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp with millisecond precision.
